author: DeDust
description: DeDust Uranus Meme V3 is a launchpad meme-token market where users buy, sell, and track a token through Uranus trading.

members.name: BondingCurveParametersMalformed
members.description: Bonding curve parameters are malformed.

members.name: SlippageExceeded
members.description: Output amount is below the supplied slippage limit.

members.name: PresetNotExist
members.description: Selected meme preset does not exist.

members.name: MessageValueTooLow
members.description: Attached GRAM value is not enough for the requested operation.

members.name: AlreadyInitialized
members.description: Meme state was already initialized.

members.name: SenderUnauthorized
members.description: Sender is not authorized for the operation.

members.name: InitialBuyLimitExceeded
members.description: Initial buy exceeds the configured limit.

members.name: BalanceExceeded
members.description: Requested amount exceeds the available balance.

members.name: NotInitialized
members.description: Meme state has not been initialized yet.

members.name: AlreadyGraduated
members.description: Meme already graduated and no longer accepts curve trading.

members.name: CrossWorkchainTransfer
members.description: Cross-workchain transfer is rejected.

members.name: IncorrectAddress
members.description: Supplied address is incorrect for the operation.

members.name: FeePresetNotExist
members.description: Selected fee preset does not exist.

members.name: TotalSupplyPresetNotExist
